title: Grand Canyon West Rim Helicopter and Boat Tour by Luxury Car
blurb:
Start your unforgettable adventure with a pickup from the Las Vegas Strip and a photo stop at the iconic Hoover Dam. You'll travel through the otherworldly Joshua Tree Forest on your way to the Grand Canyon.

Get ready for the main event: a thrilling helicopter tour. Soar 4,000 feet over the canyon, then descend 2,500 feet to witness its majestic walls up close. This 5-7 minute flight and 15-20 minute Pontoon Boat Ride offers breathtaking views you have to see to believe.

For more adventure, choose to add a scenic guided horseback ride or a high-energy ATV tour.
